descriptions.text: The Cloak of the Benevolent Champion. This is a unique item. This item was originally awarded in a Celestial Quest Box during the third floor. […] This magical cloak offers the following benefits: A level-five Find Weakened skill, so you'll always know who to protect first. Your lowest base stat will, over the course of the next 66 hours, become equal with the highest base stat at the time of first equip. Four random spells from your current arsenal will increase to level 15. …

beats.headline: Quan's cloak
beats.text: Before Carl opens his boxes, Mordecai has him pull out Quan's cloak. Watching Quan on the recap, they had assumed his flying, power bolt and shields came from the cloak; in fact its abilities are tailored to the wearer, with a focus on magic and the lowest stat, which is why Carl wants it for Donut. It is long and glows with a soft white light, silky, black on one side and blue on the other, with short arms. The system calls it a cloak, so it will fit a quadruped. Quan used its Find Weakened skill to pick off the weakest.

beats.headline: Thirty points, for two minutes
beats.text: Mordecai's new potion was once called Charisma Cheat, and the system now calls it MySpace Photo. For two minutes it makes the system read Donut's base charisma as 193 instead of 163, so the cloak will raise her constitution, base two, to 193. She learns Shield first, drinks the potion, collects a very rude Catfish achievement, and the cloak appears over her shoulders, ridiculously short on her. It's like a shawl, she says. Bad Attitude is level fifteen at once. Wall of Fire, Heal Critter and Puddle Jumper are to follow.

beats.headline: Her lovely shawl
beats.text: Huanxin Jinx has slid to a stop in a circle of words of power that stops her teleporting, shaking with rage, and Donut stalks a circle around her. She has shown off her new knee pads. She has also upgraded a skill because of her lovely shawl, she says; it is not quite at fifteen yet, but it is getting there. Does Huanxin want to know what it is? Stay the hells away from me, the heiress answers. I am a god.

beats.headline: A matched set
beats.text: One of Donut's celestial boxes held the Crupper of the Benevolent Champion, part of a matched set of four with the cloak; find the third, and the fourth will come in a box. Its abilities copy the cloak's, and the set adds more: the constitution the cloak raised is buffed another twenty per cent, Find Weakened rises to ten, and one spell the cloak brought to fifteen may go to sixteen. The cloak raised Wall of Fire, Heal Critter, Bad Attitude and Puddle Jumper, and she has to choose now. She picks Puddle Jumper, now level 16.
